verdict.what_is_wrong: PID 8192 (`python3`) in one container appears to have been constrained to roughly a quarter core while remaining runnable: it repeatedly waited tens to hundreds of milliseconds for CPU even as CPUs entered idle, and its sustained CPU time stayed near 0.23–0.24 cores. This is consistent with a per-container CPU quota, but the trace does not directly record throttling and the decisive per-period ceiling test was not run, so the cap mechanism is strongly suspected rather than conclusively proven.
